title: runBudget
responsibility: Reports measurements, limits and ledger history, and benchmarks a unit.

inputs.name: loadBudgets.root
inputs.description: Filesystem root used to load unit manifests and read the budget ledger. Defaults to process.cwd().

inputs.name: budgetMeasure.unit
inputs.description: Exact manifest id used to restrict measurements to one active unit. Defaults to undefined, which includes every active unit.

inputs.name: budgetMeasure.root
inputs.description: Working-tree root used to load manifests and their measurement index. Defaults to process.cwd().

inputs.name: budgetHistory.unit
inputs.description: Exact event.unit value used to filter ledger history. Defaults to undefined, which returns all events.

inputs.name: budgetHistory.root
inputs.description: Working-tree root used to load manifests and the budget ledger. Defaults to process.cwd() through loadBudgets.

inputs.name: budgetStatus.root
inputs.description: Working-tree root used to load active manifests and calculated baselines. Defaults to process.cwd() through loadBudgets.

inputs.name: budgetBench.input
inputs.description: Specifies the unit id, repository-relative workload JSON path, and optional target and capture labels. Evidence defaults to benchmark and state defaults to default when omitted.

inputs.name: budgetBench.root
inputs.description: Filesystem root used to resolve the unit registry and workload path and to run the benchmark. Defaults to process.cwd().

outputs.name: loadBudgets
outputs.description: Resolves to the absolute root, fresh manifests, ledger events, calculated baselines, and ledger repository for the working tree. The result contains a Map and a repository instance, which JSON cannot represent.

outputs.name: budgetMeasure
outputs.type: Promise<{ partial?: string | undefined; unavailable?: string | undefined; value: number | null; unitOfMeasure: string; target?: "process" | "http" | "wasm" | "module" | undefined; unit: string; metric: string; }[]>
outputs.description: Returns measurement rows for active manifests, optionally restricted to one exact manifest id. Rows include unit, metric, value, and unitOfMeasure, with target, unavailable, and partial only when present.

outputs.name: budgetHistory
outputs.description: Resolves to ledger events for the working tree, optionally filtered by exact event.unit. With no unit filter, it returns all events.

outputs.name: budgetStatus
outputs.type: Promise<{ baselined: number; inherited: string[]; unbaselined: string[]; unmeasured: { unit: string; metric: string; reason: string; }[]; }>
outputs.description: Returns active-unit counts and lists for baselined, inherited, unbaselined, and unmeasured units. Each unmeasured entry contains unit, metric, and reason.

outputs.name: budgetBench
outputs.description: Resolves to the benchmark result after measuring a unit through its declared runtime target. The result is also recorded as a JSON capture, using benchmark and default when evidence and state are omitted.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised by fail() when ledger reading reports errors, the requested unit is unknown, the workload fails schema validation, or the benchmark runtime returns a failed workload.
